title: Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Granola Bar

content.title: About
content.content: Nature Valley Sweet and Salty Granola Bar is a crunchy, whole‑grain snack bar coated with a sweet‑salty glaze. Made by General Mills, it is designed for on‑the‑go snacking. Each bar weighs about 42 g and contains oats, sunflower oil, honey, sugar and salt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar is made of two baked oat halves that are glued together with a glaze.
The combination of honey sweetness and sea‑salt creates the signature “sweet‑salty” flavor popular in the US.
It was first introduced in the 1970s as part of the Nature Valley line aimed at active lifestyles.
Whole oat flakes are used rather than milled flour, preserving a hearty texture.
The product contains no artificial colors or flavors.

items.title: Source of whole grains
items.content: Oats provide complex carbohydrates that release energy slowly, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestive health and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Modest protein content
items.content: Oats and sunflower oil supply about 3 g of protein per bar, useful for muscle repair.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: Sunflower oil adds polyunsaturated fatty acids that are beneficial for heart health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Oats are a source of thiamine (B1) and niacin (B3), which play roles in energy metabolism.

items.title: Gluten sensitivity
items.content: The bar contains oats, which are often processed on shared equipment with wheat, making it unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Each bar contains roughly 9 g of sugar, which may be a concern for those monitoring sugar intake.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: The bar has about 0.3 g of salt, which can add up for individuals watching sodium consumption.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: At approximately 190 kcal per bar, portion control is advisable for calorie‑restricted diets.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bar straight from the package as a quick snack. It can be chopped and added to yogurt, kefir or muesli for extra crunch, or used as a crunchy layer in dessert parfaits.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bars in their original packaging in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal the package tightly to prevent moisture absorption, which can make the bars soft.
